name: What factors affect the total cost of a home addition?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the total cost of a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost depends on square footage, site conditions, foundation requirements, and interior finishes. Simple ground-level bump-outs or single-room extensions cost significantly less than complex additions that require plumbing and specialized mechanical systems, such as in-law suites or primary bathrooms. Second-story additions require structural reinforcement of main-floor walls and existing foundations, which alters the investment. During the initial consultation, a general contractor assesses your existing structure and reviews material selections to establish a realistic scope that matches your budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on square footage, foundation needs, plumbing, electrical work, roofline integration, interior finishes, and whether you are building outward or upward.
